basic_info.description: Welcome to this 2BR/1BA loft townhome located in a gated SOMA community.  Thoughtfully arranged across four levels, the home has high ceilings, hardwood floors, and north- and south-facing windows flooding the space with light. The ground floor features a private entry and garage access with storage. The second level includes a bedroom with brand new carpet, full bath, and private balcony. On the third level, the open living and dining area, complete with a gas fireplace, connects seamlessly to a galley-style kitchen with stainless steel appliances and updated white cabinetry. The top level has a versatile second loft bedroom, which can also serve as a home office or creative space. Refinished hardwood floors and freshly painted throughout. Located near SOMA's vibrant amenities, including Whole Foods, Yerba Buena Gardens, and Westfield Shopping Center, the home offers easy access to BART, Caltrain, Salesforce Transit Center, Muni, and Highways 80, 101, and 280, ensuring convenience for both daily commutes and travel.
